module_title: Policy Impact, Amendments, and Judicial Status
introduction: The final level explores the legal teeth of these bodies, recent changes (2019 Amendment), and the friction between state and central power regarding investigating agencies.

core_concepts.title: The NHRC (Amendment) Act, 2019
core_concepts.description: Reduced the tenure of the Chairperson and members from 5 years to 3 years (or 70 years of age). It also made any SC Judge eligible for Chairperson (previously only retired CJIs).

core_concepts.title: CBI’s 'General Consent' Issue
core_concepts.description: Since Police is a State Subject (List II), CBI needs the state government's consent to investigate. If a state withdraws 'General Consent', CBI needs court permission or case-specific consent to enter.

core_concepts.title: NITI Aayog vs. Planning Commission
core_concepts.description: Unlike the PC, NITI Aayog has NO power to allocate funds. Fund allocation is now done by the Finance Ministry. PC followed a Top-Down approach; NITI follows Bottom-Up.

core_concepts.title: Vineet Narain Case (1997)
core_concepts.description: A landmark SC judgment that gave the CBI Director a fixed 2-year tenure to ensure independence from political interference.

important_entities.name: Interim Director of CBI
important_entities.significance: Often used by governments when the committee fails to reach a consensus, frequently criticized by the Judiciary.

important_entities.name: SDG India Index
important_entities.significance: Tracks states' progress on Sustainable Development Goals; a prime example of 'Competitive Federalism'.

important_entities.name: Aspirational Districts Programme
important_entities.significance: Focuses on the most backward districts to improve human development indicators.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: After the 2019 amendment, members of NHRC are now eligible for re-appointment. Previously, there were strict limits.
In Delhi, CBI doesn't need consent (as it is a UT and governed by the DSPE Act directly). The 'Consent' issue applies only to States.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The current tenure for NHRC members as per the 2019 amendment.
The SC once called the CBI a 'Caged Parrot speaking in its master's voice'—a phrase used in mains for discussing CBI's autonomy.

exam_strategy_tips: UPSC Mains focus: The debate between 'Statutory Status for CBI' and its current status under the DSPE Act.
Analyze NITI Aayog's role as a 'catalyst' rather than a 'provider' of funds.
